channel.title: World News Live
channel.description: Daily news briefs: geopolitics, tech, sports, entertainment, business and world news, in our own words.

item.title: US Strikes IRGC Missile Site on Qeshm Island After Iran's Bahrain Drone Attack
item.description: The United States has hit a missile launch site on Qeshm Island in retaliation for an Iranian drone attack on an American base in Bahrain, in a sharp escalation around the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Ukraine Strikes Crimean Bridge for Second Day, Sending Road Span Into the Sea
item.description: Ukraine has hit the bridge linking Russia with occupied Crimea for a second straight day, collapsing a section of its road span into the Kerch Strait.

item.title: MS Dhoni Ends 18-Year IPL Career as Player, Takes Over as CSK Mentor
item.description: Mahendra Singh Dhoni has retired from playing in the Indian Premier League and will serve as Chennai Super Kings' team mentor from the 2027 season.

item.title: Modi Proposes Free E-Visas for ASEAN Tourists at Manila Summit
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has proposed free e-visas for tourists from ASEAN countries and a long-term maritime cooperation plan at the summit in Manila.

item.title: MIT Designs a Smart Pill That Confirms When Medicine Is Swallowed
item.description: Engineers at MIT have built a pill that signals when it has been swallowed, using a tiny biodegradable antenna that fits inside an ordinary capsule.

item.title: YouTube Trending Today: Game Awards Nominees, 'EETHA' and the 'O.M' Trailer Lead
item.description: The Game Awards' 2026 nominee reveal tops the US chart, while in India the 'EETHA' song and the 'O.M' trailer dominate the day's viewing.

item.title: Canada and China Widen Tariff Relief as Carney Meets Xi Ahead of APEC
item.description: Canada and China have agreed to cut tariffs on more of each other's goods, as Prime Minister Mark Carney met President Xi Jinping on the sidelines of the APEC summit.

item.title: India Re-Elected to ITU Council for 2027-2030 Term
item.description: India has been re-elected to the council of the International Telecommunication Union, the UN agency for telecoms, for the 2027-2030 term.

item.title: China Confirms First-Ever Xi-Trump-Putin Summit in Shenzhen on 19 November
item.description: China has confirmed that the leaders of China, the United States and Russia will meet in Shenzhen on 19 November, in the first three-way summit of its kind.

item.title: Nvidia Board Rules Out Jensen Huang's Return as 'Bring Jensen Back' Campaign Grows
item.description: Nvidia's board is not considering bringing Jensen Huang back as chief executive, despite a petition signed by more than 180,000 people and public backing from Elon Musk and Donald Trump.

item.title: Modi Arrives in Manila for ASEAN-India and East Asia Summits
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi arrived in Manila on Monday for a three-day visit, during which he will attend the ASEAN-India Summit and the East Asia Summit.

item.title: India's Wholesale Inflation Jumps to 12.29% as Unemployment Eases to 4.9%
item.description: India's wholesale inflation quickened to 12.29% in October, while unemployment eased to 4.9% and stock markets ended higher.

item.title: Sonia Gandhi Launches Memoir 'Belonging', Says She Wanted to Set the Record Straight
item.description: Congress leader Sonia Gandhi formally launched her memoir, 'Belonging: A Journey of Love', in Delhi on Monday, saying she wanted to set the record straight about her life.

item.title: Jay Shah Re-Elected ICC Chairman for a Second Term, Unopposed
item.description: The International Cricket Council has re-elected Jay Shah as its chairman for a second consecutive term, with the decision taken unopposed.

item.title: Heat Linked to 710,000 Deaths in 2023, Lancet Countdown Report Finds
item.description: Heat was linked to an estimated 710,000 deaths worldwide in 2023, and human-caused climate change contributed to more than 70% of that toll, the Lancet Countdown's 2026 report says.

item.title: YouTube Trending Today: GTA 6, TXT's 'Angel Bite' and The Weeknd Lead the Charts
item.description: GTA 6 trailers, a new TXT music video and The Weeknd's Hong Kong release lead YouTube's trending charts in India and around the world today.

item.title: Blasts and Sirens in Bahrain as Iran Claims Drone Strike on US Base
item.description: Bahrain said its air defences intercepted several Iranian aerial attacks on Sunday, while Tehran claimed it had struck an American radar system at a base in the Gulf kingdom.

item.title: Italy Fines Meta €805 Million Over Facebook's Access to Users' Photos
item.description: Italy's privacy regulator said the Facebook app on Android phones read users' photos, videos and metadata without their specific consent, affecting around 20 million people.

item.title: Cyclone Akvan Heads for Andhra Coast as Third Storm in a Month
item.description: A depression over the Bay of Bengal is set to become a cyclonic storm on Monday and a severe cyclonic storm by Tuesday, with heavy rain forecast for coastal Andhra Pradesh, Odisha and Tamil Nadu.

item.title: India Beat New Zealand by 22 Runs to Clinch ODI Series 3-1
item.description: India bowled New Zealand out for 187 in the fifth and final ODI at Mount Maunganui, sealing a first ODI series win in New Zealand in seven years.
